name: alexfleetcommander-agent-trust-stack-mcp
description: Cryptographic provenance, bilateral blind reputation scoring, and tamper-evident logging for AI agent interactions. 7 interlocking trust protocols (CoC, ARP, ASA, AJP, ALP, AMP, CWEP) available in Python (pip) and TypeScript (npm). 663 tests. Bitcoin-anchored provenance chains, anti-Goodhart reputation scoring, machine-readable contracts, dispute resolution, lifecycle management, trust-weighted matchmaking, and context-window cost allocation. Also on [Smithery](https://smithery.ai/server/@alexfleetcommander/agent-trust-stack-mcp) and [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/agent-trust-stack-mcp/).
